final: WITH group_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(ANA) as avg_ana FROM Examination WHERE ID IS NOT NULL AND ANA IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ID), overall_mean AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ana) as mean_ana FROM group_averages) SELECT ga.ID, ga.avg_ana, ga.avg_ana - om.mean_ana as excess FROM group_averages ga CROSS JOIN overall_mean om WHERE ga.avg_ana > om.mean_ana ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10
